pick.headline: Lebanese President Rene Moawad assassinated
pick.summary: On 22 November 1989, seventeen days after taking office under the Taif Agreement, Lebanese President Rene Moawad was killed by a bomb in West Beirut.
pick.significance: His assassination struck at the Arab-brokered settlement meant to end the civil war; Elias Hrawi was elected in his place two days later.
pick.fbis: Beirut's Voice of Lebanon broke the news on 22 November: a booby-trapped car had exploded near the president's motorcade moments after he left Government House, and Mu'awwad was "martyred".

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 224, 22 November 1989
evidence.snippet: …s we receive them. Our correspondent in the Government House has just reported that the explosion which was heard in the al-Sana‘i‘ area was caused by a booby-trapped vehicle and occurred moments after President Rene Mu‘awwad left the Government House.
